messages:
Sam (Support): triage handoff — several trials can't finish onboarding, customers report 'activation pending' after SSO ok. getting repeated timeouts on provisioning worker.
Ana (CSM): which accounts and any renewal risk?
Sam (Support): HelioHealth (pilot, 60 seats, renewal 2026-08), SproutLab (trial, 10 seats, trial ends in 6d), VeroDocs (pilot, 25 seats).
Dev (SE): logs: provisioning worker returns 202 but team state not updated. snippet: `WARN activator: transition timeout team_id=th_77 after 240s`. suspect activator queue deadlock after last queue change. cc @ops-bot for incident.
ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-241 created, priority=P1, assigned=@dev_se. Runbook: provisioning-activator-hang.
Taylor (CS Ops): comms plan: 1) Proactive note to HelioHealth + SproutLab within 30m; 2) Provide manual activation steps for CS; 3) Offer expedited onboarding session for HelioHealth. Ana will lead customer outreach.
Ana (CSM): I'll send messages and schedule call with HelioHealth. SproutLab I'll call (trial).
Dev (SE): short-term workaround: web admin -> Teams -> Force Activate, or `POST /internal/v1/team/force_activate {team_id}`. I'll generate a scoped, 2h token for Sam.
Sam (Support): please attach curl.
Dev (SE): `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer TEMP-FORCE-XXX" https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/team/force_activate -d '{"team_id":"<team_id>"}'` — do not paste token in public logs.
Sam (Support): running force_activate for HelioHealth now. will confirm.
Dev (SE): rolling a canary rollback of activator queue refactor. monitoring metrics 10m.
Sam (Support): HelioHealth activated, SproutLab activated via manual flow, VeroDocs confirmed on call. Ana: all three acknowledged workaround.
Ana (CSM): thanks — logging follow-ups: HelioHealth needs renewal playbook + possible credit, SproutLab converted to short paid trial after call.
Taylor (CS Ops): status page updated and comms record filed: https://redwood.internal/cs/records/INC-2026-241. Owners: Dev -> postmortem, Ana -> customer follow-ups, Sam -> support timeline. Check-in cadence 30m until postmortem posted.
ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-241 status -> resolved, resolved_by=@dev_se, resolution_summary="rollback + manual activation".
Ana (CSM): closing loop — will flag HelioHealth in renewal tracker and schedule 1:1.
Sam (Support): closing after postmortem link posted.
Taylor (CS Ops): postmortem created and linked in record. Closing in 2h after customer follow-ups complete.
